source: Reference unsupported_policy_claim judge (v3) prevalence; example traces from live Langfuse review
why_agent_can_change_it: In all three traces the agent's reply asserts something no retrieved document or tool result backs. In support-0187 it suggests an expired return window 'should be reconsidered', in support-0241 it cites cw-returns and cw-refunds without ever retrieving them, and in support-0089 it implies a replacement is available. Each is the agent's own wording, not a tool output, so the system prompt can tell it to state only what retrieved documents or tool results support and to say so when a source was not retrieved.
